what: Tally (form builder) crossed $6M ARR and 2.5M users after 6 years, team of 10, bootstrapped product-led.
why_us: Конкретные ARR-цифры нишевого no-code форм-билдера; долгий трек и повторяемый паттерн инди-хакерского роста.

what: PressDrop.io: $700 revenue in 3 weeks after launch. Press-release distribution to 500+ outlets. First sale day 1, then silence, then sales after showing product on X. Price path cheap → $99 early bird, target ~$199.
why_us: Свежий launch с цифрами и дистрибуционным инсайтом (show > tell). Ниша PR-для-стартапов платежеспособна.

what: BeatAPI: 744 signups in 25 days, ~$900 revenue. 284 billed API usage, 33 topped up. SEO from decision-pages for developers.
why_us: Свежие цифры конверсии signup→usage→pay. Боль активации API-продукта явна.

what: Joke-tweet «they should make a super app where you can visit any website you want» hit 1580 likes / 180 replies / 124 quotes in one day. People still want a WeChat-like everything-app in the West.
why_us: Высокий engagement (>100 likes с запасом) на demand gap супер-аппа. Тема повторяется в 2026 (AI workspaces as proto-super-app).

what: Replit G2 cons: expensive, confusing billing, annual lock-in. User spent $5k+, $250/mo through Apr 2027, no downgrade. 68 mentions of expensive.
why_us: Повторяющаяся боль цены vibe-coding IDE. Платежеспособная аудитория (SMB/инди). Щель для cheaper / transparent-credits alternative.

what: Harvest time-tracking: Trustpilot 1.9. Long-term users report 5x–8x price hikes ($6k→$30k/yr; $12→$116.50/seat). Freelancers and SMBs fleeing.
why_us: Классический SaaSacre-гэп: incumbents raise prices, buyers seek cheaper focused tools.

what: Ask HN: local/non-cloud Wispr Flow alternative for on-device dictation. Replies: Handy (OSS), VoiceInk ($25), Glimpse, FluidVoice.
why_us: Свежий privacy demand gap: voice-to-text without cloud. Есть willingness to pay ($25+) и OSS-ниша.

what: Show HN: ReacherX — open-source Apollo alternative. Live search X+LinkedIn in plain English instead of static sales DB. Built because finding people in 2026 is still hard.
why_us: Прямой demand gap vs Apollo/sales-intel. Founder-first, not sales-ops. Open-source wedge.

what: @harisahmad59: 24yo solo, $1k MRR while finishing CS degree. Audience 200k+. Built own SaaS products from room.
why_us: Свежий micro-SaaS revenue snapshot + distribution via audience.

what: QR-code app doing $200k MRR launched <1 year ago despite native camera QR being free. Screenshot via @peekly_app.
why_us: Контринтуитивный сигнал: commodity-feature монетизируется на B2B-обёртке (аналитика, бренд, динамические коды).

what: AI-wrapper trap: 53% of SaaS listings are AI-flavored but basic wrappers sell at 1.0x–1.6x revenue because of churn. Separate take: wrapper might clear ~$50k/yr vs $210k subscription product.
why_us: Анти-сигнал для категории: wrappers легко строить, тяжело продать. Нужен мот + данные, не только GPT UI.

what: Narrative cluster: 200 claw machines bringing real cashflow onto Solana, claimed 12–15% monthly yield / transparent RWA vs speculative loops. Parallel: OnRe ONyc reinsurance yield 9–15%.
why_us: Свежий RWA-yield тред (не только farm APY). Нужна проверка on-chain, но повторяемость темы за 24ч высока.
engagement: cluster of same-day posts, low likes

what: Indie founder cut weekly growth+revenue audit from 3 hours to 3 minutes with parallel agents on Stripe + GA4 + Search Console + PostHog. Cross-query: mobile traffic drop vs failed payments vs rankings.
why_us: Боль соло-фаундера: сшивать analytics+billing. Готовый шаблон микро-SaaS/agent product.

what: Warp.dev Trustpilot: users flipping 5→1 star after Build Plan + broken BYOK, no Anthropic prompt caching so Opus on large repos costs full input tokens. «Waste of money / usage limits».
why_us: Боль AI-terminal: pricing + BYOK + caching. Платящие разработчики ищут предсказуемый cost control.

what: Vizard G2: 27 mentions expensive for individual creators; plan limits (watermark, storage, export) on lower tiers. Video-snippet tool priced for teams, not solo creators.
why_us: Повторяющаяся боль AI-video clippers: creator-tier pricing gap.
revenue: yearly fee too high for beginners
